<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Asynchronous (`SubmissionKind` `RETURN_OUTCOME`). The authorization must be
known and still `AUTHORIZED`, `nodeId` must be the advice's node and belong to
the vendor. Lines the advice never authorized are reported, never refused
(goods on the dock are never turned away); the network records them as
unexpected and restocks nothing of them. On `202` the advice leaves the poll
and the network publishes `VendorReturnOutcomeSubmitted`.
